## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 2 ago 2026 - 12 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _A Google user_, 12 sept 2026, 1/5: "I had been using this app since 2013. Since then the software has become bloated with features I don't need or want, and popups you have to click through every time you open the app to tell you about them. After 13 years with this app, the cumbersome glitchy nature of the app combined with a jaw-dropping price increase was enough to make me quit the platform and find something else."
            2. _Caitlin Colvin_, 11 sept 2026, 1/5: "I expected the app to be pushy about paying for it. But if the app crashes within 5 minutes of me downloading it, I'm not inclined to want to keep using it. It took forever to load every time I opened it. Not helpful for jotting down a quick note. Such a shame, used to hear such good things about this."
            3. _Troy Fairchild_, 7 sept 2026, 1/5: "Obnoxious and intrusive adds now make the free version unusable. Today is my last day using this app. They have ruined it."
<!--/ir-theme-->
